gaps.sentence: I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).

gaps.sentence: They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
Is it worth ___ the engine or should we buy a new car?
My parents wouldn't let me ___ out that late.
gaps.explanation: let takes the bare infinitive: let me go (no 'to').
